baseline_checks.name: contact_submit_thank_you
baseline_checks.detail: TimeoutError: Page.wait_for_selector: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. | page_path_at_failure=/contact | visible_h1='Contact us'

proposal.root_cause: The Send button in contact.html has type="button", so clicking it never submits the form. The POST to /contact never happens, the success page with 'Thank you' is never rendered, and the test times out on /contact. The form action and method already match the Flask route.
proposal.reason: A type="submit" button triggers the form's POST to /contact, which renders success.html containing 'Thank you'. This matches the current source and the failure evidence (still on /contact with the h1 'Contact us').

proposals.diff:
--- a/fixture_site/templates/contact.html
+++ b/fixture_site/templates/contact.html
@@ -12,7 +12,7 @@
     <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required>
     <label for="message">Message</label>
     <textarea id="message" name="message" rows="4" required></textarea>
-    <button id="send" type="button">Send message</button>
+    <button id="send" type="submit">Send message</button>
   </form>
 </body>
 </html>

ProofLoop VERIFIED FIX (run 20261016-143051-c51304). Failing check(s) contact_submit_thank_you with symptom: page_path_at_failure=/send-message | visible_h1='Not Found'. Root cause: The contact form in contact.html posts to /send-message, but the Flask app only defines POST /contact. Submitting the form therefore lands on a 404 'Not Found' page and the 'Thank you' text never appears. Fix that worked: in fixture_site/templates/contact.html replace 'action="/send-message"' with 'action="/contact"'. Independently verified in a cloud browser: candidate 3/3 checks passed.
